description: The shipyard's mallets at Port Royal by day: blows on oak, a short knock of a falling tone and a crack of noise, in runs of a few blows beat seconds apart with rests between, from the slip. A point source, heard within reach metres. Frequencies in Hz, times in seconds, levels as gains.
